surface.name: Gemini Interactions API via REST
surface.selection_basis: Google's current getting-started guide makes the Interactions API the default first-call surface and documents an SDK-free REST request.

alternatives_considered.name: generateContent API
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: The guide still exposes this route through a toggle, but currently presents Interactions as the default.

alternatives_considered.name: Vertex AI
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: Vertex AI requires Google Cloud project, billing, API, and IAM state and is tracked in the cloud-platform cohort.

entry_point.developer_intent: Create a Gemini API key and receive text from the Interactions REST API.
assumed_prior_state: A browser and terminal with cURL are available.

documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated Gemini Interactions request returns model-generated text.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The response has status completed and a model_output step containing text.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The REST quickstart shows a completed Interaction with model output text.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The returned model output is the first meaningful API result, before streaming, multimodal, tool, and multi-turn extensions.

prerequisites.requirement: A Google account able to use Google AI Studio.
A Gemini API key. AI Studio automatically creates a project and key for new users or can create another key-project pair.
An HTTPS client such as cURL.

primary_path.action: Sign in to Google AI Studio and open API keys.
primary_path.success_signal: The API keys page is reachable.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Account access follows Google's sign-in flow.

primary_path.action: Copy the automatically created key or create a new API key.
primary_path.success_signal: The key is available to the shell.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Paid-tier upgrade is optional for the first call but requires Cloud Billing and prepaid credits.

primary_path.action: POST the documented text prompt to https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions with x-goog-api-key.
details: Send JSON containing a model and input.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Invalid credentials, model, or quota return an API error.

primary_path.action: Confirm that the response contains a model_output text step.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: A response without generated text does not meet the boundary.

branches.condition: The developer upgrades to the paid tier.
branches.path: Link Cloud Billing, add a payment method, and prepay at least the documented minimum.
branches.effect_on_first_success: Raises limits but is not required when the free tier can serve the first request.

friction_gates.description: A Gemini API key is required.

sources.title: Getting started with the Gemini API
sections_used: Install the SDK and make your first call
evidence_supported: REST endpoint, headers, request, and completed response

uncertainties.question: Does every new account receive usable free-tier quota in every supported region?
uncertainties.impact: Could add a billing gate before first success.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The quickstart describes paid-tier upgrade as optional but does not establish universal account eligibility.
